scope: Read-only R21 billing and double-entry ledger metadata audit with tenant-scoped payment relations, validated constraints, unique indexes, trigger signatures, migration identity, and live cross-tenant data check.

constraints.name: BillingMonthClose_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: BillingPlanVersion_capabilities_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((capabilities <@ ARRAY['security.company_policy'::text, 'security.ip_access'::text, 'security.mfa_management'::text, 'security.sso_login_policy'::text]) AND (array_position(capabilities, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (cardinality(capabilities) = (((
CASE
    WHEN ('security.company_policy'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN ('security.ip_access'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN ('security.mfa_management'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN ('security.sso_login_policy'::text = ANY (capabilities)) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END))))

constraints.name: BillingPlanVersion_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT orderable) OR ((cycle <> 'trial'::text) AND ("priceKrw" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: BillingPlanVersion_planId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("planId") REFERENCES "BillingPlan"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: BillingSubscription_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['trialing'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND ("planId" = 'trial'::text) AND ("priceKrw" = 0) AND ("activationSource" = 'trial'::text) AND ("periodStart" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" > "periodStart") AND (("cancelAt" IS NULL) OR (("cancelAt" > "periodStart") AND ("cancelAt" <= "periodEnd")))) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND ("planId" <> 'trial'::text) AND ("priceKrw" IS NOT NULL) AND ("activationSource" IS NULL) AND ("periodStart" IS NULL) AND ("periodEnd" IS NULL) AND ("cancelAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'active'::text) AND ("planId" <> 'trial'::text) AND ("priceKrw" IS NOT NULL) AND ("activationSource" = 'payment'::text) AND ("periodStart" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" > "periodStart") AND (("cancelAt" IS NULL) OR (("cancelAt" > "periodStart") AND ("cancelAt" <= "periodEnd")))) OR ((status = 'expired'::text) AND ("planId" <> 'trial'::text) AND ("priceKrw" IS NOT NULL) AND ("activationSource" = 'payment'::text) AND ("periodStart" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" IS NOT NULL) AND ("periodEnd" > "periodStart") AND (("cancelAt" IS NULL) OR (("cancelAt" > "periodStart") AND ("cancelAt" <= "periodEnd"))))))

constraints.name: BillingSubscription_planId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("planId") REFERENCES "BillingPlan"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: BillingSubscription_planVersionId_planId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("planVersionId", "planId") REFERENCES "BillingPlanVersion"(id, "planId") ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: BillingSubscription_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: BillingSubscriptionEvent_subscriptionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("subscriptionId") REFERENCES "BillingSubscription"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: CreditAccount_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: LedgerEntry_transactionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("transactionId") REFERENCES "LedgerTransaction"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: LedgerTransaction_reservationId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("reservationId") REFERENCES "LedgerTransaction"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: LedgerTransaction_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'funding'::text) AND ("sourceKind" = 'pg_capture'::text) AND ("serviceId" IS NULL) AND ("reservationId" IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'refund'::text) AND ("sourceKind" = 'payment_refund'::text) AND ("serviceId" IS NULL) AND ("reservationId" IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'reserve'::text) AND ("serviceId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reservationId" IS NULL)) OR ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['capture'::text, 'release'::text])) AND ("serviceId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reservationId" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: LedgerTransaction_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: LedgerTransaction_tenantId_serviceId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentEvent_order_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("orderId") REFERENCES "PaymentOrder"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentMethod_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind = ANY (ARRAY['card'::text, 'transfer'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'revoked'::text])) AND (provider ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$'::text) AND ("tokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("tokenCipher" ~~ 'v1.%'::text) AND (length(regexp_replace(label, '[^0-9]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)) < 13) AND ((char_length(label) >= 1) AND (char_length(label) <= 40))))

constraints.name: PaymentMethod_tenant_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentOrder_method_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "methodId") REFERENCES "PaymentMethod"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentOrder_subscription_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "subscriptionId") REFERENCES "BillingSubscription"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentRefund_order_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "orderId") REFERENCES "PaymentOrder"("tenantId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: PaymentRefund_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'rejected'::text])) AND (amount > 0) AND (amount <= '1000000000000'::bigint) AND (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text) AND ((length(reason) >= 1) AND (length(reason) <= 500)) AND (version > 0) AND ((status <> 'refunded'::text) OR ("providerRef" IS NOT NULL))))

triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.billing_subscription_event_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BILLING_EVENT_IMMUTABLE'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ledger_entry_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND pg_trigger_depth() >= 2 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'LEDGER_ENTRY_DIRECT_CHANGE_DENIED';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ledger_transaction_immutable()
